visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with black pigtails wearing a light beige romper with a palm tree pattern is sitting on a light-colored wooden floor in an indoor residential setting. An adult’s hand, featuring visible tattoos on the forearm, is seen arranging a series of colorful frog-shaped toy blocks in a straight line on the floor. In the background, there is a light-colored wooden bookshelf filled with children's books and a small blue backpack. The room is brightly lit with what appears to be natural indoor light. (2) The girl watches intently as the adult hand continues to line up the frog blocks. She points a single finger at the toys, appearing to be in a learning or focused state. Close-up shots capture her facial expressions, which alternate between concentration and curiosity. The adult's hands are precisely placing the green, blue, orange, and yellow frog toys to form a domino-style arrangement. (3) The girl reaches out and pushes the first frog block, causing the entire row to tumble over in a sequence. She reacts with a smile and looking down at the scattered toys. The adult hand reaches in to pick up the fallen blocks and begins to reset them. Text captions appear on the screen intermittently to describe the actions taking place. (4) The camera shows a top-down view of the girl's hands and the adult's hands working together to rebuild the domino line. The girl attempts to place a green frog herself, showing careful coordination. The scene changes through several quick cuts showing different stages of the toy setup. The girl remains seated with her legs spread on the wooden floor. (5) After the blocks are successfully lined up again, the girl uses a light touch to initiate another domino fall. She watches the colorful frogs collapse one by one and responds by clapping her hands together joyfully. She laughs and looks toward the adult off-camera. The video concludes with a transition to a pink end-card featuring a cartoon girl character and the brand text overlay.
